title: Draft: MATE: Memory fixes
description:
Start to try to actually free the memory that MATE allocates.
Deregister the hfids registered by MATE. This is necessary in
order to allow MATE to be reconfigured - and to prevent MATE
from crashing if MATE refers to a dynamically allocated field,
e.g. one added by HTTP/2.

commits_data.message:
MATE: Memory fixes

Start to try to actually free the memory that MATE allocates.
Deregister the hfids registered by MATE. This is necessary in
order to allow MATE to be reconfigured - and to prevent MATE
from crashing if MATE refers to a dynamically allocated field,
e.g. one added by HTTP/2.
